scope: Structured follow-up database routing integrated with the observed server source snapshot
root_causes: Structured extraction discarded the database-routing field
Ordinary, surface and compound entrypoints independently followed model source advice
Optional dataset reuse could silently fall back to a fresh query
Prefixed display-limit requests were interpreted as rankings

behavior.explicit_no: Use a scoped immutable conversation result; unavailable results terminate without a database fallback
behavior.compound: Keep task-specific route choices instead of replacing a plan with a root snapshot
behavior.dependent: Keep predecessor identity constraints separate from whether the child needs new data
behavior.cache: Do not mix explicit database routes in result deduplication or message fingerprints
behavior.display: Preserve the current node order and distinguish display limits from numeric ranking

verification.notes: Full regression continued through pre-existing collection errors; counts do not mean the entire suite passed. This comparison covers the captured source snapshot, not concurrent changes made afterward. Older local planner tests also differ from the native server planner contract; these assertions were not rewritten.

blockers: Existing failing release gate requires an applicable explicit exception
